urteile.grund: I checked the PDF. The field «Name:» has the tooltip «Nachname» and sits in the block that identifies the foreign person (Name, Vorname, Geburtsdatum, ZEMIS-NR.). It is not labelled as a previous or new name; the changed name comes in only through the passport copy. So it is the person's current official surname, and the current-value element applies. nameOnForeignPassport (eCH-0011/0045/0173) is not fitting, because the field does not ask for the name in the passport. eCH-0044 (Genehmigt) has officialName (id 800, personIdentificationLightType, baseNameType), copied verbatim. This matches the databank's usual mapping of «Name» (20x). It confirms the existing assignment. ech_herkunft is empty (not propagiert), so the verdict is «besser», not «korrekt».

«Vorname:» (PDF tooltip «Vorname») is the first name of the foreign person in the identification block. It is not marked as a past or changed value. eCH-0044 (Genehmigt) has firstName (id 801, personIdentificationLightType), copied verbatim. This is the usual mapping (23x). It confirms the existing assignment, which is not propagiert.

«Geburtsdatum:» is the date of birth of the foreign person (DVSH definition: «Geburtsdatum der ausländischen Person»). eCH-0044 (Genehmigt) has dateOfBirth (id 804, datePartiallyKnownType), copied verbatim. It confirms the existing assignment, which is not propagiert.

The ZEMIS number identifies the person in the federal migration information system. It is not the AHV number, so vn does not fit. I searched the catalogue for zemis, foreigner and personId elements and for standard titles with ZEMIS/Ausländer/Migration: none has a dedicated ZEMIS element. eCH-0223 (Einwohnerdienst–Migrationsamt) uses only personIdentification. eCH-0044 (Genehmigt) has otherPersonId (id 795, namedPersonIdType, with personIdCategory e.g. CH.ZEMIS), the element for third-party person identifiers, copied verbatim. I verified the databank maps every ZEMIS field the same way: «ZEMIS-Nummer» on forms 497 and 508–513, «ZEMIS-NR.» on 506, form 584, and the parts «Zemis-Nr.» / «ZEMIS Nr.». It confirms the existing assignment, which is not propagiert.

This is a required attachment («Notwendige Unterlagen/Dokumente als Beilage einzureichen»): a copy of the passport showing the changed name or nationality. It is a file, not a value to enter, so value elements such as nameOnForeignPassport or nationalityData do not fit. I searched passport, travel and identity-document elements: none is a document container. eCH-0223 has a document element too, but it is a message-level interface element without a status. The generic dossier/document standard eCH-0039 (Genehmigt) has document (id 772, contentType, documentType), copied verbatim. This matches the databank's mapping of comparable Migrationsamt attachments («Belege» 499, «Nachweis der finanziellen Situation beilegen» 508/512) and of «Familienausweis im Original» (548). Correction to the first review: the other «Kopie des gültigen Reisepasses…» field (form 214) is not mapped, so it is not a precedent. It confirms the existing assignment, which is not propagiert.
urteile.feld: Kopie des gültigen Reisepasses mit dem geänderten Namen/geänderter Nationalität
